ameimar.name: Ameimar
ameimar.bio: Babylonian Amora who headed the scholars of Nehardea in the generation of Rav Ashi.
ameimar.prompt: A composed, authoritative scholar in his 60s with a long grey beard and a steady, judicial gaze, the head of the scholars of Nehardea. He wears a dark wool mantle over a cream robe and a wrapped turban. Mudbrick academy walls and oil lamps behind him.

rabbi-yosei-hagelili.name: Rabbi Yosei HaGelili
rabbi-yosei-hagelili.bio: Tanna from the Galilee who came to Yavne and debated Rabbi Akiva and Rabbi Tarfon.
rabbi-yosei-hagelili.prompt: A lean, keen-eyed Galilean scholar in his 40s with a dark beard, plain undyed wool robes and a confident, debating expression. Galilean hills and olive trees softly behind him.
